result.title: Can business help nature win?
result.description:
Can businesses make more money by restoring nature? According to new research, the answer is yes.

New research has found 50 ways that businesses in areas that span the range of business itself (think everything from fashion to agriculture to recycling to mining) can both make money and leave nature better-off. The research discovered that globally, $7 trillion is spent every year destroying nature, and only about $200 billion protecting it.

Laura Fisher leads the World Economic Forum's work on nature-positive industries.

Here she breaks down the practical (and simple) ways businesses can grow while giving back to nature.

Read about all 50 Investible Opportunities for a New Nature Economy here: https://www.weforum.org/publications/50-investible-opportunities-for-a-new-nature-economy-insight-report/

#NaturePositive #SustainableBusiness #NatureEconomy #BusinessInnovation #Sustainability

result.title: Jaguar Conservation & How Quantum Computing Impacts Data Security | WEF | Stories of the Week
result.description:
This week's top stories of the week include:

00:12 - How quantum computing impacts data security:
The world is counting down to Q-Day, when quantum computers will be so powerful that they can break the #encryption that keeps your private data safe. Hackers know this is coming, so they are stockpiling data now that they can use in the future to manipulate individuals or compromise national security, says Rebecca Krauthamer, CEO and Co-Founder of cybersecurity company QuSecure. Here, she talks us through the dangers to privacy posed by the arrival of quantum computing, and explains what we can do to keep our data safe.

03:43 - How young people are tackling plastic pollution:
Global Shapers Semina Šatara, Li Weijie and Valentina Velasquez Portnoy unveil the out-of-the-box solutions they’ve found for beating plastic #pollution, from clean-ups that go viral to mapping #plastic sources through citizen science.

07:34 - Ex-racing driver leads jaguar conservation:
Mário Haberfeld used to race cars for Jaguar Brazil Racing. Today he champions the conservation of jaguars in Brazil and around the world. Haberfeld's charity, Onçafari, has pioneered a way to reintroduce #jaguars into the wild. A successful project in Brazil’s Pantanal, the world’s biggest wetland, has also brought an #ecotourism boom to the area and given the world a blueprint for big cat conservation. Here’s how they did it.

result.description:

result.title: Find your purpose after major setbacks: Katie Piper on how to adapt, reinvent and lead
result.description:
What do you do when life changes in an instant—and the future you envisioned disappears? Advocate and author Katie Piper explains how she rebuilt her life after surviving an acid attack at 24 driven by a man she'd briefly dated, founded a burn-rehabilitation charity and reframed “Why me?” as “What now?” It’s a special conversation about resilience, personal reinvention and leading through adversity.

You’ll learn:
-Why real confidence comes from knowing you can adapt and recover
-How the ease of a modern world can make us less able to embrace challenge for growth
-How to see challenge as a way to recommit to your purpose
-How acceptance, discomfort and a self-authored identity can help you start again
-Why vulnerability and empathy are strengths in leadership
Katie Piper OBE is a bestselling author, television presenter and founder of the Katie Piper Foundation, which supports burn survivors through rehabilitation. Her documentary, 'Katie: My Beautiful Face', was nominated for a BAFTA in 2010. She is also a survivor of male violence and an advocate for people with burns and visible differences.
This conversation explores resilience, purpose, trauma recovery, inclusive leadership and turning pain into purpose. Follow Meet the Leader on YouTube, Spotify or podcast apps, and subscribe for more conversations with people shaping the world

This interview was recorded in January 2026 at the World Economic Forum’s Annual Meeting in Davos Switzerland.
